crossRefs.note: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.
They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,
Has a nation changed its gods, which really are no gods? But my people have changed their glory for that which doesn’t…
but this thing I commanded them, saying, ‘Listen to my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people. Walk…
But they didn’t listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart…
But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.
When the people saw that Moses delayed coming down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron…
But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned…
Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.
They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has…
